categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Labeled Validation and modifies AssumeUTXO snapshot loading and deserialization validation in src/validation.cpp and src/node/utxo_snapshot.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents malformed AssumeUTXO snapshots from reporting inflated coin counts and fixes an interrupt bypass during snapshot deserialization. The PR description notes that repeated outpoints collapse into one coin while matching the committed UTXO hash, and empty transaction groups fail to advance the coin counter, bypassing loop interruption checks that could delay node shutdown.
